title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (18/20): Seeing a Doctor Online
note_en: Doubling a one-syllable verb with 了 in between, as in 让医生看了看他的嗓子 "let the doctor take a look at his throat," makes the action brief and casual. English adds words like "take a look" or "have a quick check," but Chinese just repeats the verb: 看了看, 想了想, 摸了摸.
